candidate_windows.window_text: We use a pre-trained model from the huggingface library. For the standard response selection model, we use AdamW as the optimizer. The learning rate is an initial value of 1e-6, and get_linear_schedule_with_warmup provided by the huggingface library is used for the learning rate scheduler. The maximum value of 10 is used for the gradient clipping. The training epoch is 10, the model is evaluated on the validation data for each epoch, and the best model is selected. In prompt-based fine-tuning, the training epoch is 5, and the rest are the same as the standard response selection. All experiments are performed on one A100 GPU, and the results are for a single turn because there is little variation between each run.
